scripts.build: prisma generate && node scripts/sync-css.mjs && node scripts/sync-static.mjs && node scripts/build-shell.mjs && node scripts/build-sw.mjs && node scripts/deploy.mjs && next build
scripts.spike: for s in s1-neon-role s3-pooler s5-schema-check s2-isolation s6-prisma-wrapper s4-delete s7-door s8-raya-migration s9-row-write; do node spike/$s.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.spike:red: for b in 's1-neon-role --break=no-force' 's1-neon-role --break=bypass' 's3-pooler --break=bare-set' 's5-schema-check --break=add-table' 's5-schema-check --break=no-force:tactics' 's5-schema-check --break=bare-fk' 's2-isolation --break=no-policy:tactics' 's2-isolation --break=owner' 's6-prisma-wrapper --break=escape' 's4-delete --break=no-cascade:measures' 's7-door --break=follow-slug' 's7-door --break=two-refusals' 's8-raya-migration --break=short:people' 's8-raya-migration --break=wrong-tenant' 's9-row-write --break=full-write' 's9-row-write --break=silent-fallback'; do node spike/$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:door:red: for b in no-rows first-person membership-key; do node checks/door-landing.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:state:red: for b in apply-on-base no-save-lock bare-refusal viewas-widens log-for-all peek-includes-me; do node checks/state-api.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:shell:red: for b in no-route open-csp keep-caches serve-from-disk; do SMP_BREAK=$b node checks/shell.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:blob:red: for b in store-first watch-truthy; do node checks/blob-api.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:comms:red: for b in no-boundary chat-on; do node checks/comms-api.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:upload:red: for b in no-inserts no-deletes; do node checks/upload-seam.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:room:red: node checks/schema-room.mjs --break=public >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: public"; exit 1; }; echo "red: public"
scripts.check:deploy:red: for b in ignore-app unanchored; do node checks/deploy-context.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
scripts.check:demo:red: for b in raw-names keep-marks; do node checks/demo-seed.mjs --break=$b >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "NOT RED: $b"; exit 1; }; echo "red: $b"; done
